- Wed 9/16: 9:00–10:00 AM or 3:00–4:00 PM
- Thu 9/17: 10:00–11:00 AM

High-level asks for the call:
- Walkthrough of CAIQ/SIG scope and any Redwood-specific questions
- Evidence matrix and upload method options (SFTP / secure upload portal / Drive)
- Log sample requirements (time window, formats, obfuscation guidance)
- Timeline for final artifact delivery and attestation

Could you confirm who from Redwood should join and which of the proposed slots work?

Hi Alex — great to hear from you and thanks for the doc. We can take the meeting and recommend the following attendees from our side:
- Evelyn Hart (Security Partnerships) — primary for the SIG intake and scheduling
- Marissa Cole (Security Onboarding Lead) — evidence owners and artifact handoff
- Jonas Weber (Compliance Engineer) — CAIQ mapping and logging specifics

We can do Wed 9/16 at 9:00 AM PT. If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite.

Pre-call notes / asks from Redwood:
- Please flag any high-sensitivity fields that cannot be shared (PHI subsets, customer PII) so we can advise on redaction/partial exports.
- For log samples: send a sample export of 24–72 hours initially (preferred formats: gzipped JSON or CSV). We'll advise on sampling windows during the call.
- Confirm whether you prefer a one-time upload to your portal or to provide us upload credentials so we can pull artifacts (we support SFTP, Azure Blob SAS, and secure share links).

I'll attach our onboarding runbook (redwood_evidence_runbook_v1.pdf) for the team to skim before the call.

See you Wed — will send invite shortly.

2) CAIQ / SIG walkthrough (15m)
3) Evidence matrix review — what Helios will provide vs Redwood samples (15m)
4) Logging sample requirements and redaction guidance (15m)
5) Next steps, timelines, and owners (10m)

- Key management description (KMS/HSM details) and retention policy doc
- Any existing SOC 2 reports or attestations (if applicable)
